_comment: The roadmaps shown on the household and cleaner pages. Checked against the app repo on 1 Nov 2026 (main 3fdb49f) and the Stage 5/6 handoff notes. Nothing goes in 'now' unless it is built and working in the test version. 'testing' = built, switched on after checks. 'later' = planned, not built, no dates. Move an item only when the app changes.
